relations.text: MongoDBの年次報告が、主要3クラウド事業者との提携拡大を挙げている
relations.text_en: MongoDB's annual report says it expanded business partnerships with all three major cloud providers (AWS, GCP and Microsoft Azure)

source.label: MongoDB 10-K
source.quote: For example, we have expanded our business partnerships with all three major cloud providers (AWS, GCP and Microsoft Azure) to enhance our joint marketing initiatives, deliver technology integrations that benefit customers and align with our sales strategy.

relations.text: Alibaba Cloudと組み、中国で認可を受けたMongoDB-as-a-Serviceを提供している
relations.text_en: Expanded its partner ecosystem with Alibaba Cloud to offer an authorized MongoDB-as-a-Service in China

source.label: MongoDB 10-K
source.quote: We have expanded our global partner ecosystem with Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud to offer an authorized MongoDB-as-a-Service solution in China, allowing their customers to easily adopt and consume our hosted solution.

companies.name: テンセント
companies.sub: インターネット・クラウド

relations.text: 2021年2月にTencent Cloudとのグローバル提携を発表した
relations.text_en: Announced a global partnership with Tencent Cloud in February 2021

source.label: MongoDB 10-K
source.quote: In addition, we expanded our reach in China in February 2021 when we announced a global partnership with Tencent Cloud that allows customers to easily adopt and use MongoDB-as-a-Service across Tencent’s global cloud infrastructure.

relations.text: DigitalOceanがMongoDBと提携し、フルマネージドのデータベースサービスを提供している
relations.text_en: DigitalOcean offers a fully managed database service in partnership with MongoDB

source.label: DigitalOcean 10-K
source.quote: We currently offer managed offerings for relational databases (SQL) such as PostgreSQL and MySQL, a NoSQL database such as DigitalOcean Managed MongoDB, a fully-managed database as a service offering in partnership with MongoDB, and a high-performance key-value caching service such as Managed Caching for Valkey.
